text: A non-performing asset (NPA) is a loan or advance for which the principal or interest payment remained overdue for a period of 90 days. Sub-standard assets are those which have remained NPA for a period not exceeding 12 months. Doubtful assets are those which have remained NPA for more than 12 months. Loss assets are those where loss has been identified by the bank or auditor but the amount has not been written off

text: Banks should not charge and take to income account, interest on any NPA. Interest on NPAs should be booked only when it is actually received. Banks may reverse the interest already charged and not collected

text: Banks are required to make provision for NPAs based on classification: Sub-standard 15%, Doubtful 25-100%, Loss assets 100%. Provision is made on a quarterly basis

text: All banks and NBFCs must follow fair practices code in their dealings with borrowers. title: Banks must ensure that their recovery agents follow the guidelines issued by RBI. Recovery agents should not resort to i
text: Banks must ensure that their recovery agents follow the guidelines issued by RBI. Recovery agents should not resort to intimidation, harassment, or violence. Recovery calls should be made only between 7 AM and 7 PM. Identity cards must be carried. Agents must inform the borrower of the details of the dues and the name of the bank. Banks are responsible for the actions of their recovery agents

text: Banks must have a grievance redressal mechanism for borrowers. A complaint can be filed with the Banking Ombudsman under the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021 if the bank does not resolve the complaint within 30 days

text: RBI framework allows borrowers facing temporary financial difficulties to request restructuring of their loans. Restructuring may include extension of repayment period, reduction in interest rate, conversion of outstanding interest into term loan, or granting of moratorium. The borrower must demonstrate viability and submit a restructuring proposal

text: Special resolution framework allowing one-time restructuring for personal loans, MSME loans and corporate loans affected by the pandemic. Invocation must be done within the prescribed window. Moratorium period up to 2 years for personal loans

text: All loan disbursements and repayments must be executed between the bank accounts of the borrower and the regulated entity without any pass-through of third party. text: All banks and NBFCs must follow fair practices code in their dealings with borrowers. Banks are responsible for the actions of their recovery agents

text: RBI framework allows borrowers facing temporary financial difficulties to request restructuring of their loans. Restructuring may include extension of repayment period, reduction in interest rate, conversion of outstanding interest into term loan, or granting of moratorium. The borrower must demonstrate viability and submit a restructuring proposal

text: All loan disbursements and repayments must be executed between the bank accounts of the borrower and the regulated entity without any pass-through of third party. Lending Service Providers and Digital Lending Apps must comply with RBI guidelines. Key requirements: disclosure of all-inclusive cost of digital loans, cooling-off period for borrowers, data privacy protections, prohibition on accessing mobile phone data without consent

text: All digital lending platforms must complete KYC verification as per RBI norms. Video-KYC is permitted for accounts up to specified limits. Re-KYC must be done periodically

text: If the borrower fails to discharge liability within 60 days, the secured creditor may take possession of the secured assets, take over management of the business, appoint any person to manage the secured assets, or require any person who has acquired any of the secured assets to pay the secured creditor

title: The secured creditor may take recourse to measures including: taking possession of secured assets, sale or lease or assi
text: The secured creditor may take recourse to measures including: taking possession of secured assets, sale or lease or assign the right over secured assets, take over management of the secured assets, appoint any person to manage the secured assets, require persons owing money to borrower to pay the secured creditor instead. This includes auction of property and seizure of assets

title: If the dues of the secured creditor together with all costs charges and expenses incurred are tendered to the secured cr
text: If the dues of the secured creditor together with all costs charges and expenses incurred are tendered to the secured creditor at any time before the date fixed for sale or transfer, the secured assets shall not be sold or transferred

title: The Chief Metropolitan Magistrate or District Magistrate shall take possession of such asset and forward such asset to t
text: The Chief Metropolitan Magistrate or District Magistrate shall take possession of such asset and forward such asset to the secured creditor on receiving a written request from the secured creditor

text: Management of secured assets and right of redemption by borrower at any time before the secured asset is sold

text: Any person including borrower aggrieved by any measures taken by the secured creditor may make an application to the Debts Recovery Tribunal (DRT) within 45 days. title: Application of Civil Code. Elements: This Law shall apply to all civil matters not governed by special laws, Matters sha
text: Application of Civil Code. Elements: This Law shall apply to all civil matters not governed by special laws, Matters shall be governed by the provisions of this Law in the absence of any special provision. Remedies: Court shall apply provisions of Islamic Sharia where appropriate, Customary practices may be considered where not contrary to public policy. Process: File claim in competent civil court, Court hearing and evidence presentation, Judgment execution through execution department

title: Interpretation of Law. Elements: The Court shall interpret the Law according to the principles of Islamic Sharia, Custom
text: Interpretation of Law. Elements: The Court shall interpret the Law according to the principles of Islamic Sharia, Customary practices shall be considered where they do not contradict public policy. Remedies: Judicial interpretation of ambiguous provisions, Reference to Islamic Sharia principles. Process: Court interpretation during proceedings, Appeal to higher courts for clarification

title: Essential Elements of Contract. Elements: Offer and acceptance, Legal capacity of contracting parties, Lawful object and
text: Essential Elements of Contract. Elements: Offer and acceptance, Legal capacity of contracting parties, Lawful object and consideration, Definite subject matter. Remedies: Contract rescission for invalidity, Damages for breach, Specific performance, Compensation for loss. Process: Mediation attempt (mandatory in some emirates), Civil court proceedings, Appeal to Court of Appeal, Cassation Court for final appeal

title: Scope and Application. Elements: This Law shall apply to all commercial companies established in the UAE, Includes LLCs,
text: Scope and Application. Elements: This Law shall apply to all commercial companies established in the UAE, Includes LLCs, joint stock companies, and other forms of commercial entities. Remedies: Dissolution of company, Shareholder derivative actions, Director liability for breach of duties. Process: Registration with Department of Economic Development, Commercial license issuance, Annual license renewal and audit requirements

title: Limited Liability Company Formation. Elements: Minimum two shareholders, Minimum capital as prescribed by law, Memorandu
text: Limited Liability Company Formation. Elements: Minimum two shareholders, Minimum capital as prescribed by law, Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, Manager or Board of Managers. Remedies: Shareholder oppression remedies, Dissolution for deadlock, Buyout of minority shareholders. Process: Notarization of founding documents, Registration with relevant authority, Commercial license application, Publication in official gazette

title: Foreign Ownership Restrictions. Elements: Foreign ownership limited to specific sectors, Local sponsor requirement (51%
text: Foreign Ownership Restrictions. Elements: Foreign ownership limited to specific sectors, Local sponsor requirement (51% ownership), Special approvals for certain activities. Remedies: Forced divestment of excess ownership, Contract termination, Penalties for non-compliance. Process: Application for foreign ownership license, Approval from relevant authorities, Registration of ownership changes

title: Scope of Application. Elements: Applies to all employment relationships in UAE, Includes federal and local government em
text: Scope of Application. Elements: Applies to all employment relationships in UAE, Includes federal and local government employees, Excludes certain categories as specified. Remedies: Unpaid wages recovery, End of service gratuity, Compensation for unfair dismissal. Process: Labour dispute settlement through Ministry, Labour court proceedings, Appeal to higher labour courts

title: Employment Contract Requirements. Elements: Written contract mandatory for all employees, Clear terms on wages, working
text: Employment Contract Requirements. Elements: Written contract mandatory for all employees, Clear terms on wages, working hours, leave, Job description and responsibilities, Probation period not exceeding 6 months. Remedies: Contract termination compensation, Gratuity payment, Notice period compensation. Process: Written notice of termination, Ministry of Human Resources mediation, Labour court claim if dispute arises

title: Working Hours and Leave. Elements: Maximum 8 hours per day, 48 hours per week, Rest breaks and weekly rest day, Annual l
text: Working Hours and Leave. Elements: Maximum 8 hours per day, 48 hours per week, Rest breaks and weekly rest day, Annual leave entitlement (30 days), Sick leave and maternity leave provisions. Remedies: Overtime pay for excess hours, Compensation for denied leave, Additional pay for work on rest days. Process: Report violation to Ministry, Labour inspection, Court proceedings for enforcement

title: Marriage Requirements. Elements: Islamic marriage contract (Aqd al-Nikah), Consent of both parties, Guardian consent for
text: Marriage Requirements. Elements: Islamic marriage contract (Aqd al-Nikah), Consent of both parties, Guardian consent for woman, Dowry (Mahr) specification, Two Muslim male witnesses. Remedies: Divorce (Talaq) by husband, Judicial divorce (Khula) by wife, Maintenance and child support, Property rights division. Process: Marriage registration at Sharia court, Personal Status Court proceedings, Appeal to Court of Appeal, Cassation Court for final appeal

title: Divorce Procedures. Elements: Husband's right to unilateral divorce (Talaq), Wife's right to judicial divorce (Khula), C
text: Divorce Procedures. Elements: Husband's right to unilateral divorce (Talaq), Wife's right to judicial divorce (Khula), Court approval for certain divorces, Reconciliation attempts mandatory. Remedies: Iddah period observance, Maintenance during Iddah, Child custody determination, Property and dowry settlement. Process: Reconciliation committee involvement, Court proceedings for contested divorces, Appeal procedures, Execution of court orders

title: Application to Non-Muslims. Elements: Applies to Christians, Hindus, Sikhs, Buddhists, and others, Recognition of religi
text: Application to Non-Muslims. Elements: Applies to Christians, Hindus, Sikhs, Buddhists, and others, Recognition of religious marriages and divorces, Child custody and guardianship matters. Remedies: Divorce proceedings according to religious law, Property division, Child support and custody orders. Process: Civil court jurisdiction, Mediation mandatory before litigation, Court judgment based on religious principles

title: Marriage and Divorce for Non-Muslims. Elements: Recognition of marriages performed according to religious rites, Divorce
text: Marriage and Divorce for Non-Muslims. Elements: Recognition of marriages performed according to religious rites, Divorce according to religious procedures, Court registration requirement. Remedies: Maintenance and support orders, Property settlement, Child custody and access rights. Process: Registration with Civil Status Department, Court proceedings for disputes, Appeal to higher courts

title: No Crime or Punishment Without Law. Elements: No act shall be considered a crime unless provided by law, No punishment s
text: No Crime or Punishment Without Law. Elements: No act shall be considered a crime unless provided by law, No punishment shall be imposed except by virtue of a law, No heavier punishment than prescribed by law. Punishment: As prescribed by specific articles. Process: Police investigation, Public prosecution review, Criminal court trial, Appeal to Court of Appeal, Cassation Court final appeal

title: Theft. Elements: Taking movable property, Belonging to another person, Without the owner's permission, With intent to ap
text: Theft. Elements: Taking movable property, Belonging to another person, Without the owner's permission, With intent to appropriate permanently. Punishment: Imprisonment from 1 month to 3 years and/or fine from AED 1,000 to 50,000. Process: Police report (FIR equivalent), Investigation and evidence collection, Public prosecution charging, Criminal court trial

title: Robbery. Elements: Theft accompanied by force or threat of force, Against person or property, With intent to steal. Puni
text: Robbery. Elements: Theft accompanied by force or threat of force, Against person or property, With intent to steal. Punishment: Imprisonment from 5 to 15 years. Process: Emergency police response, Forensic evidence collection, Fast-track prosecution, Criminal court trial

title: Assault Causing Bodily Harm. Elements: Intentional assault, Causing bodily harm, Without aggravating circumstances. Puni
text: Assault Causing Bodily Harm. Elements: Intentional assault, Causing bodily harm, Without aggravating circumstances. Punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year and/or fine up to AED 10,000. Process: Medical examination, Police investigation, Prosecution and trial

title: Criminal Defamation. Elements: Publication or broadcast of false information, Damaging reputation of another, Intent or
text: Criminal Defamation. Elements: Publication or broadcast of false information, Damaging reputation of another, Intent or recklessness. Punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years and/or fine up to AED 100,000. Process: Private criminal complaint, Investigation, Court proceedings, Civil remedies also available

title: Scope and Definitions. Elements: Crimes committed using information technology, Includes computers, networks, and electr
text: Scope and Definitions. Elements: Crimes committed using information technology, Includes computers, networks, and electronic devices, Both local and cross-border offenses. Punishment: As specified in individual articles. Process: Digital evidence preservation, Specialized cybercrime unit investigation, Federal court jurisdiction, International cooperation for cross-border crimes

title: Unauthorized Access to Information Systems. Elements: Intentional access to information system, Without authorization, W
text: Unauthorized Access to Information Systems. Elements: Intentional access to information system, Without authorization, With intent to obtain information or cause damage. Punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year and/or fine up to AED 500,000. Process: Digital forensics investigation, ISP cooperation for data access, Specialized prosecution, Federal criminal court trial

title: Data Interference. Elements: Intentional alteration, deletion, or destruction of data, Without authorization, Causing da
text: Data Interference. Elements: Intentional alteration, deletion, or destruction of data, Without authorization, Causing damage to system or data. Punishment: Imprisonment from 6 months to 5 years and/or fine from AED 50,000 to 1,000,000. Process: System forensics analysis, Data recovery attempts, Criminal prosecution, Civil damages claims

title: Electronic Fraud. Elements: Use of information technology to commit fraud, False representation or deception, Financial
text: Electronic Fraud. Elements: Use of information technology to commit fraud, False representation or deception, Financial gain or loss to others. Punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years and/or fine up to AED 5,000,000. Process: Financial investigation, Banking records analysis, Joint investigation with financial authorities, Specialized court proceedings

title: Definitions and Scope. Elements: Control of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances, Prevention of trafficking and ab
text: Definitions and Scope. Elements: Control of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances, Prevention of trafficking and abuse, International cooperation provisions. Punishment: As specified for each offense category. Process: Drug enforcement administration coordination, Forensic laboratory testing, Specialized narcotics courts, International extradition procedures

title: Possession of Narcotics. Elements: Knowing possession of narcotic substance, Without legal authorization, For personal u
text: Possession of Narcotics. Elements: Knowing possession of narcotic substance, Without legal authorization, For personal use or distribution. title: Drug Trafficking. Elements: Importation, exportation, or transportation of narcotics, Manufacturing or production, Large
text: Drug Trafficking. Elements: Importation, exportation, or transportation of narcotics, Manufacturing or production, Large quantities indicating trafficking intent. Punishment: Life imprisonment or death penalty for large quantities. Process: Undercover operations, International cooperation, Specialized prosecution unit, Supreme court jurisdiction for death penalty cases

title: Traffic Violations. Elements: Violation of traffic rules and regulations, Endangering public safety, Reckless driving be
text: Traffic Violations. Elements: Violation of traffic rules and regulations, Endangering public safety, Reckless driving behavior. Punishment: Fines, license suspension, imprisonment. Process: Traffic police enforcement, Traffic violation ticketing, Court proceedings for serious offenses, License suspension procedures

title: Driving Under Influence. Elements: Driving vehicle while intoxicated, Blood alcohol level above legal limit, Impaired dr
text: Driving Under Influence. Elements: Driving vehicle while intoxicated, Blood alcohol level above legal limit, Impaired driving ability. Process: Breathalyzer or blood test, Vehicle impoundment, Court appearance, Driver rehabilitation program

title: Human Rights Protection. Elements: Protection of fundamental human rights, Equality before law, Freedom from discriminat
text: Human Rights Protection. Elements: Protection of fundamental human rights, Equality before law, Freedom from discrimination. Remedies: Right to fair trial, Freedom of expression, Right to privacy, Freedom of assembly. Process: Complaint to Human Rights Commission, Investigation, Mediation, Court proceedings

title: Right to Work. Elements: Right to employment without discrimination, Equal pay for equal work, Safe working conditions.
text: Right to Work. Elements: Right to employment without discrimination, Equal pay for equal work, Safe working conditions. Remedies: Employment discrimination claims, Workplace harassment remedies, Unfair dismissal compensation. Process: Complaint to Ministry of Human Resources, Labour court proceedings, Compensation awards, Reinstatement orders

title: Annual Leave Entitlement. Elements: Employee with continuous service, Minimum 30 days annual leave per year, Pro-rata ca
text: Annual Leave Entitlement. Elements: Employee with continuous service, Minimum 30 days annual leave per year, Pro-rata calculation for incomplete year. Remedies: Payment for untaken leave, Carry forward of leave, Cash compensation for unused leave. Process: Leave application to employer, Employer approval, Leave payment calculation, Dispute resolution through labour court

title: Sick Leave Provisions. Elements: Medical certificate required, Up to 90 days sick leave per year, Half pay for extended
text: Sick Leave Provisions. Elements: Medical certificate required, Up to 90 days sick leave per year, Half pay for extended sick leave. Remedies: Sick pay entitlement, Job protection during sick leave, Medical expense reimbursement. Process: Medical certificate submission, Employer verification, Sick pay calculation, Labour dispute resolution

text: LLC Formation Requirements. Elements: Minimum 2 shareholders, Minimum capital AED 150,000, Local service agent requirement, Commercial license. text: Branch Office Establishment. Elements: Parent company incorporation certificate, Board resolution for branch, Local service agent, Activity license. text: Free Zone Establishment. Elements: Federal approval for free zone, Infrastructure development, Regulatory framework, Investment incentives. title: Driving with Excess Alcohol. Elements: Driving or attempting to drive motor vehicle, Alcohol level above legal limit (80
text: Driving with Excess Alcohol. Elements: Driving or attempting to drive motor vehicle, Alcohol level above legal limit (80mg/100ml blood or 35mcg/100ml breath). Punishment: Maximum 6 months imprisonment, £5,000 fine, and disqualification. Process: Breath test or blood test, Police station procedure, Trial in Magistrates' Court, Drink driving rehabilitation course

title: Breach of Implied Terms - Satisfactory Quality. Elements: Contract for sale of goods, Goods not of satisfactory quality,
text: Breach of Implied Terms - Satisfactory Quality. Elements: Contract for sale of goods, Goods not of satisfactory quality, Consumer contract (business to consumer). Remedies: Repair of goods, Replacement of goods, Price reduction (partial refund), Rescission (full refund), Damages for consequential loss. Process: Inform seller of breach within reasonable time, Request repair, replacement, or refund, Mediation through Consumer Rights helpline, County Court claim if unresolved, Appeal to Circuit Judge

title: Breach of Implied Terms - Description. Elements: Goods sold by description, Goods do not match description, Description
text: Breach of Implied Terms - Description. Elements: Goods sold by description, Goods do not match description, Description became term of contract. Remedies: Rejection of goods, Price reduction, Damages for breach. Process: Reject goods within reasonable time, Claim refund or damages, Court proceedings if disputed

title: Unfair Contract Terms. Elements: Consumer contract, Term causes significant imbalance between parties, Term not individu
text: Unfair Contract Terms. Elements: Consumer contract, Term causes significant imbalance between parties, Term not individually negotiated, Contrary to good faith. Remedies: Term declared void or unenforceable, Court may substitute fair term, Damages for loss caused. Process: Complaint to Citizens Advice, County Court proceedings, Reference to Trading Standards, Injunction to prevent use of unfair terms

title: Credit Agreement Disputes. Elements: Goods or services purchased on credit, Faulty goods or unsatisfactory service, Cred
text: Credit Agreement Disputes. Elements: Goods or services purchased on credit, Faulty goods or unsatisfactory service, Credit agreement over £100, under £30,000. Remedies: Claim against credit card company, Up to £30,000 compensation, Same remedies as against supplier. Process: Complain to supplier first, Claim against credit card company within 6 months, Financial Ombudsman Service arbitration, County Court proceedings if necessary

title: Services Not Carried Out with Reasonable Skill. Elements: Contract for supply of services, Services not performed with r
text: Services Not Carried Out with Reasonable Skill. Elements: Contract for supply of services, Services not performed with reasonable care and skill, Consumer contract. Remedies: Repeat performance of service, Price reduction, Damages for loss suffered. Process: Inform service provider of breach, Request repeat performance or refund, Mediation through Consumer Rights helpline, County Court claim

title: Child Welfare Disputes. Elements: Dispute about child's upbringing, Court must consider child's welfare as paramount, No
text: Child Welfare Disputes. Elements: Dispute about child's upbringing, Court must consider child's welfare as paramount, No delay in proceedings. Remedies: Child arrangements orders (custody/access), Specific issue orders, Prohibited steps orders, Parental responsibility orders. Process: Mediation Information and Assessment Meeting (MIAM), Family Court proceedings, CAFCASS (Children and Family Court Advisory Service) involvement, First Hearing Dispute Resolution (FHDRA), Final hearing with judgment

title: Child Arrangements Disputes. Elements: Dispute about where child lives or spends time, Best interests of child paramount
text: Child Arrangements Disputes. Elements: Dispute about where child lives or spends time, Best interests of child paramount consideration. Remedies: Child lives with order, Child spends time with order, Other contact orders, Conditions attached to orders. Process: Mandatory mediation attempt, Court application under Part 19 Family Procedure Rules, Safeguarding checks, Fact-finding hearing if domestic abuse alleged, Final welfare hearing

title: Petition for Divorce. Elements: Marriage has broken down irretrievably, One of five facts proven:, Adultery, Unreasonabl
text: Petition for Divorce. Elements: Marriage has broken down irretrievably, One of five facts proven:, Adultery, Unreasonable behaviour, Desertion for 2+ years, 2 years separation with consent, 5 years separation without consent. Remedies: Decree nisi (conditional divorce), Decree absolute (final divorce), Financial remedies, Property adjustment orders, Pension sharing orders. Process: File divorce petition at court, Serve petition on respondent, Acknowledgment of service, Decree nisi granted after 6 weeks, Decree absolute after 6 weeks (or 3 months if contested)

title: Financial Settlement Disputes. Elements: Ancillary relief proceedings, Division of matrimonial assets, Fair distribution
text: Financial Settlement Disputes. Elements: Ancillary relief proceedings, Division of matrimonial assets, Fair distribution based on needs and contributions. Remedies: Lump sum orders, Property transfer orders, Periodic payment orders (maintenance), Pension attachment orders, Clean break orders. Process: Form E financial disclosure, First directions appointment, Financial dispute resolution hearing, Final hearing with judgment, Variation possible if circumstances change

title: Domestic Violence Protection. Elements: Associated persons (spouses, cohabitants, family), Molestation (violence or thre
text: Domestic Violence Protection. Elements: Associated persons (spouses, cohabitants, family), Molestation (violence or threats of violence). Remedies: Non-molestation orders, Occupation orders, Undertakings accepted by court, Power of arrest attached to orders. Process: Without notice application in urgent cases, On notice application with 2 weeks' notice, Interim orders granted immediately, Final hearing within 14 days, Breach proceedings if violated

title: Adverse Possession Claims. Elements: Factual possession of registered land for 10 years, Intention to possess, Possessio
text: Adverse Possession Claims. Elements: Factual possession of registered land for 10 years, Intention to possess, Possession must be adverse to paper owner, No consent from owner. Remedies: Registration of title in squatter's name, Possessory title granted. Process: Application to Land Registry, HM Land Registry investigation, Objection period (65 business days), Registration if no valid objection, Appeal to Property Chamber

title: Breach of Leasehold Covenants. Elements: Leasehold property, Breach of repair covenant, Failure to maintain property. Re
text: Breach of Leasehold Covenants. Elements: Leasehold property, Breach of repair covenant, Failure to maintain property. Remedies: Specific performance (court orders repairs), Damages for breach, Forfeiture of lease possible. Process: Serve section 146 notice, County Court proceedings, Appointment of receiver, Enforcement of court orders

title: Unfair Dismissal. Elements: Employee with 2 years' continuous service, Dismissal not for potentially fair reason, Or dis
text: Unfair Dismissal. Elements: Employee with 2 years' continuous service, Dismissal not for potentially fair reason, Or dismissal procedurally unfair. Remedies: Re-instatement to job, Re-engagement in suitable alternative, Compensation up to statutory maximum (£93,878 for 2024/25), Basic award for redundancy element. Process: Early conciliation through ACAS, ET1 claim to Employment Tribunal, Case management discussion, Preliminary hearing, Full merits hearing, Appeal to Employment Appeal Tribunal

title: Unfair Redundancy Selection. Elements: Redundancy situation exists, Employee selected unfairly, No genuine redundancy or
text: Unfair Redundancy Selection. Elements: Redundancy situation exists, Employee selected unfairly, No genuine redundancy or improper procedure. Remedies: Re-engagement or re-instatement, Compensation based on age, length of service, weekly pay, Basic award (up to 12 weeks' pay), Statutory redundancy pay. Process: ACAS early conciliation, Tribunal claim within 3 months, Case management, Merits hearing, Compensation calculation

title: Direct Discrimination. Elements: Protected characteristic (age, sex, race, disability, etc.), Less favourable treatment
text: Direct Discrimination. Elements: Protected characteristic (age, sex, race, disability, etc.), Less favourable treatment because of protected characteristic, No justification for treatment. Remedies: Declaration of discrimination, Compensation (no upper limit), Recommendations to employer, Injunctions against future discrimination. Process: Grievance procedure with employer, ACAS early conciliation, ET1 claim to Employment Tribunal, Case management preliminary hearing, Full merits hearing, Appeal to Employment Appeal Tribunal

title: Indirect Discrimination. Elements: Policy, criterion, or practice (PCP), PCP disadvantages people with protected charact
text: Indirect Discrimination. Elements: Policy, criterion, or practice (PCP), PCP disadvantages people with protected characteristic, No justification for PCP, Claimant disadvantaged by PCP. Remedies: Declaration of discrimination, Compensation for injury to feelings, Recommendations to end discriminatory practice, Injunctions. Process: Internal grievance procedure, ACAS conciliation, Tribunal proceedings, Statistical evidence often required

title: Breach of Weekly Rest Period. Elements: Worker entitled to 24 hours' uninterrupted rest per week, Employer fails to prov
text: Breach of Weekly Rest Period. Elements: Worker entitled to 24 hours' uninterrupted rest per week, Employer fails to provide rest period, No opt-out agreement. Remedies: Payment for work during rest period (double time), Injunction to prevent future breaches, Compensation for detriment. Process: Report to Health and Safety Executive, Employment Tribunal claim, Enforcement through civil courts

title: Denial of Annual Leave. Elements: Worker with 3 months' service, Entitled to 5.6 weeks' paid annual leave, Employer refu
text: Denial of Annual Leave. Elements: Worker with 3 months' service, Entitled to 5.6 weeks' paid annual leave, Employer refuses to allow leave or pay for untaken leave. Remedies: Payment for untaken leave, Carry forward of leave, Additional compensation for detriment. Process: Formal request for leave, ACAS early conciliation, Employment Tribunal claim, Holiday pay calculations

title: Negligence - Breach of Duty. Elements: Defendant owed claimant duty of care, Defendant breached that duty, Breach caused
text: Negligence - Breach of Duty. Elements: Defendant owed claimant duty of care, Defendant breached that duty, Breach caused claimant's damage, Damage not too remote (foreseeable). Remedies: Damages for pain and suffering, Loss of earnings, Medical expenses, Future care costs. Process: Pre-action protocol compliance, Letter of claim, Court proceedings in County Court or High Court, Quantum assessment, Appeal to Court of Appeal

title: Defamation by Publication. Elements: Statement referring to claimant, Statement lowers claimant in estimation of right-t
text: Defamation by Publication. Elements: Statement referring to claimant, Statement lowers claimant in estimation of right-thinking people, Statement published to third party, No defence available (truth, privilege, honest opinion, etc.). Remedies: Damages (compensatory and/or aggravated), Injunction to prevent further publication, Declaration that statement is defamatory. Process: Letter of claim demanding correction/apology, Pre-action protocol compliance, County Court or High Court proceedings, Trial with jury for quantum, Appeal possible

title: Private Nuisance. Elements: Unlawful interference with claimant's use of land, Substantial interference, Interference un
text: Private Nuisance. Elements: Unlawful interference with claimant's use of land, Substantial interference, Interference unreasonable. Remedies: Injunction to stop nuisance, Damages for past interference, Abatement (claimant may remove nuisance). Process: Letter before action, County Court claim, Injunction application (interim and final), Assessment of damages

title: Trespass to Land. Elements: Direct physical interference with claimant's land, Without lawful justification, Without cla
text: Trespass to Land. Elements: Direct physical interference with claimant's land, Without lawful justification, Without claimant's consent. Remedies: Injunction to prevent trespass, Damages for loss suffered, Mesne profits (value of unauthorised use). Process: Letter demanding cessation, County Court proceedings, Possessory remedies available, Self-help remedies in some cases

title: Right to Life Protection. Elements: Protection of life by law, No arbitrary deprivation of life, Effective investigation
text: Right to Life Protection. Elements: Protection of life by law, No arbitrary deprivation of life, Effective investigation of deaths. Remedies: Judicial review of state actions, Compensation for violations, Injunctions against harmful policies, Declaration of incompatibility. Process: Application for judicial review, Permission stage, Substantive hearing, Appeal to Court of Appeal, Supreme Court final appeal

title: Protection from Torture and Inhuman Treatment. Elements: Absolute prohibition of torture, No exceptions even in emergenc
text: Protection from Torture and Inhuman Treatment. Elements: Absolute prohibition of torture, No exceptions even in emergency, Protection from inhuman and degrading treatment. Remedies: Damages for violations, Judicial review proceedings, Injunctions against deportation, Declaration of unlawfulness. Process: Urgent application to High Court, Interim relief possible, Full judicial review hearing, Appeal procedures

title: Right to Liberty and Security. Elements: No arbitrary arrest or detention, Right to be informed of reasons, Right to cha
text: Right to Liberty and Security. Elements: No arbitrary arrest or detention, Right to be informed of reasons, Right to challenge lawfulness, Right to compensation for unlawful detention. Remedies: Habeas corpus applications, Judicial review of detention, Damages for false imprisonment, Compensation claims. Process: Application for habeas corpus, Urgent court hearing, Review of detention grounds, Release or continued detention order

title: Right to Fair Trial. Elements: Independent and impartial tribunal, Determination within reasonable time, Public hearing
text: Right to Fair Trial. Elements: Independent and impartial tribunal, Determination within reasonable time, Public hearing in criminal cases, Right to legal assistance. Remedies: Stay of proceedings, Quashing of convictions, Compensation for delay, Judicial review of court procedures. Process: Application to European Court of Human Rights, Domestic judicial review, Appeal against conviction, Compensation proceedings

title: Right to Private and Family Life. Elements: Respect for private life, Protection of family life, Protection of home, Pro
text: Right to Private and Family Life. Elements: Respect for private life, Protection of family life, Protection of home, Protection of correspondence. Remedies: Injunctions against privacy invasions, Damages for breach, Judicial review of surveillance, Data protection claims. Process: Claim for breach of privacy, Application for injunction, Judicial review proceedings, Compensation claims

title: Freedom of Expression. Elements: Freedom to hold opinions, Freedom to receive and impart information, Restrictions must
text: Freedom of Expression. Elements: Freedom to hold opinions, Freedom to receive and impart information, Restrictions must be prescribed by law, Necessary in democratic society. Remedies: Injunctions against censorship, Damages for defamation, Judicial review of restrictions, Declaration of rights violation. Process: Pre-action correspondence, Court proceedings for injunction, Appeal against restrictions, European Court of Human Rights

title: Data Protection Principles. Elements: Lawful, fair and transparent processing, Purpose limitation, Data minimisation, Ac
text: Data Protection Principles. Elements: Lawful, fair and transparent processing, Purpose limitation, Data minimisation, Accuracy of data, Storage limitation, Integrity and confidentiality, Accountability. Remedies: Compensation for damage, Rectification of inaccurate data, Erasure of data (right to be forgotten), Restriction of processing, Data portability. Process: Complaint to Information Commissioner, Investigation by ICO, Enforcement notice, Tribunal appeal, Court proceedings

title: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten). Elements: Personal data no longer necessary, Consent withdrawn, Unlawful proce
text: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten). Elements: Personal data no longer necessary, Consent withdrawn, Unlawful processing, Public interest grounds. Remedies: Erasure of personal data, Restriction of processing, Compensation for non-compliance, Injunctions against further processing. Process: Subject access request, Erasure request to controller, ICO complaint if refused, Tribunal proceedings, Court enforcement

title: Compensation for Data Protection Breaches. Elements: Material or non-material damage, Breach of GDPR provisions, Causati
text: Compensation for Data Protection Breaches. Elements: Material or non-material damage, Breach of GDPR provisions, Causation link between breach and damage, No exclusion of liability. Remedies: Compensation for material damage, Compensation for non-material damage (distress), Punitive damages possible, Legal costs recovery. Process: Pre-action correspondence, County Court claim, Assessment of damages, Appeal procedures

title: Immigration Control. Elements: Non-EEA national entering UK, Without leave to enter or remain, Subject to immigration co
text: Immigration Control. Elements: Non-EEA national entering UK, Without leave to enter or remain, Subject to immigration control. Remedies: Leave to remain, Judicial review of decisions, Protection from deportation, Family life considerations. Process: Immigration application, Refusal decision, Administrative review, Judicial review in High Court, Appeal to Upper Tribunal

title: Carrier Liability for Unlawful Entry. Elements: Carrier brings passenger to UK, Passenger does not have entry clearance,
text: Carrier Liability for Unlawful Entry. Elements: Carrier brings passenger to UK, Passenger does not have entry clearance, Carrier failed to check documents. Remedies: Repatriation costs recovery, Civil penalties up to £2,000 per passenger, Injunctions against carriers, Asset seizure. Process: Immigration enforcement action, Penalty notice, Appeal to magistrates court, Recovery proceedings

title: Statutory Nuisance Control. Elements: Premises in such state as to be prejudicial to health, Unreasonable interference w
text: Statutory Nuisance Control. Elements: Premises in such state as to be prejudicial to health, Unreasonable interference with enjoyment of premises, Accumulation of waste causing nuisance. Remedies: Abatement notice, Court injunction, Damages for nuisance, Cleanup costs recovery. Process: Complaint to local authority, Investigation and inspection, Abatement notice service, Appeal to magistrates court, Enforcement proceedings

title: Waste Management Licensing. Elements: Carrying on waste management activity, Without appropriate licence, Deposit of con
text: Waste Management Licensing. Elements: Carrying on waste management activity, Without appropriate licence, Deposit of controlled waste. Remedies: Stop notices, Cleanup notices, Financial penalties, Cost recovery. Process: Environment Agency investigation, Enforcement notice, Appeal to Secretary of State, Court proceedings for non-compliance

title: Unfair Credit Relationships. Elements: Credit agreement with individual, Relationship unfair to consumer, Court finds re
text: Unfair Credit Relationships. Elements: Credit agreement with individual, Relationship unfair to consumer, Court finds relationship unfair. Remedies: Setting aside of agreement, Return of goods or money paid, Compensation for losses, Penalty charges repayment. Process: Complaint to Financial Ombudsman, County Court claim, Assessment of unfairness, Remedial order by court

title: Enforcement of Credit Agreements. Elements: Creditor seeking to enforce agreement, Agreement improperly executed, Consum
text: Enforcement of Credit Agreements. Elements: Creditor seeking to enforce agreement, Agreement improperly executed, Consumer prejudiced by irregularity. Remedies: Enforcement prevented, Damages for harassment, Compensation for losses, Legal costs recovery. Process: Defence filed in court, Evidence of improper execution, Court determination, Appeal procedures

title: Assured Tenancy Security. Elements: Assured shorthold tenancy, Fixed term expired, Continued occupation, No steps to end
text: Assured Tenancy Security. Elements: Assured shorthold tenancy, Fixed term expired, Continued occupation, No steps to end tenancy. Remedies: Statutory continuation, Security of tenure, Rent increase restrictions, Deposit protection. Process: Tenancy agreement review, Notice to quit service, Court possession proceedings, Appeal against possession order

title: Section 21 Eviction Notice. Elements: Assured shorthold tenancy, Fixed term expired, Landlord serves section 21 notice,
text: Section 21 Eviction Notice. Elements: Assured shorthold tenancy, Fixed term expired, Landlord serves section 21 notice, Minimum notice period given. Remedies: Court possession order, Compensation for harassment, Rent repayment orders, Damages for disrepair. Process: Section 21 notice service, Court proceedings if tenant doesn't leave, Possession hearing, Warrant for possession

title: Directors' Duty to Promote Success. Elements: Director of UK company, Duty to act in good faith, Promotion of company su
text: Directors' Duty to Promote Success. Elements: Director of UK company, Duty to act in good faith, Promotion of company success, Consideration of stakeholders. Remedies: Shareholder derivative claims, Unfair prejudice petitions, Director disqualification, Compensation for breach. Process: Shareholder resolution, Court petition, Investigation by Insolvency Service, Disqualification proceedings

title: Unfair Prejudice to Shareholders. Elements: Company conduct unfairly prejudicial, To interests of shareholders, Affairs
text: Unfair Prejudice to Shareholders. Elements: Company conduct unfairly prejudicial, To interests of shareholders, Affairs conducted in discriminatory manner, Equitable considerations. Remedies: Share purchase order, Company winding up, Director removal, Compensation payment. Process: Petition to court, Evidence of unfair prejudice, Court valuation, Remedial order

title: Copyright Infringement. Elements: Work protected by copyright, Defendant copied substantial part, Without licence or per
text: Copyright Infringement. Elements: Work protected by copyright, Defendant copied substantial part, Without licence or permission, Infringing act done in UK. Remedies: Injunction to prevent infringement, Damages or account of profits, Delivery up of infringing copies, Legal costs recovery. Process: Letter before action, Court proceedings, Evidence of ownership, Assessment of damages

title: Criminal Copyright Infringement. Elements: Making copies for sale or hire, Exposing for sale infringing copies, Possessi
text: Criminal Copyright Infringement. Elements: Making copies for sale or hire, Exposing for sale infringing copies, Possession of illicit recording equipment, Commercial scale infringement. Punishment: Up to 10 years imprisonment and/or unlimited fine. Process: Police investigation, Search and seizure, Crown Prosecution Service review, Crown Court trial

text: Medical Negligence. Elements: Doctor-patient relationship, Breach of duty of care, Reasonable foreseeability of harm, Causation between breach and harm. Remedies: Compensation for pain and suffering, Loss of earnings, Medical expenses, Future care costs. Process: Letter of claim to defendant, Medical expert reports, Pre-action protocol compliance, Court proceedings, Quantum assessment

title: Medical Treatment Standards. Elements: Treatment fell below acceptable standard, Bolam test: would reasonable body of pr
text: Medical Treatment Standards. Elements: Treatment fell below acceptable standard, Bolam test: would reasonable body of professionals agree, Patient suffered harm, Harm reasonably foreseeable. Remedies: Damages for substandard treatment, Corrective surgery costs, Rehabilitation expenses, Loss of amenity compensation. Process: Medical expert evidence, Court assessment of standard, Causation analysis, Damages calculation

text: Insurance Contract Disputes. Elements: Valid insurance contract, Breach of warranty or condition, Material fact not disclosed, Claim denied due to breach. Remedies: Policy avoidance, Claim payment, Damages for breach, Contract rescission. Process: Complaint to insurer, Financial Ombudsman Service, County Court proceedings, Appeal procedures

text: Insurance Misrepresentation. Elements: Material fact misrepresented, Induced insurer to enter contract, Misrepresentation fraudulent or negligent, Affected insurer's decision. Remedies: Contract voidable, Damages for misrepresentation, Claim denial, Premium return. Process: Insurer investigation, Disclosure of misrepresentation, Court proceedings, Remedial orders

text: Estate Administration. Elements: Death of person leaving estate, Estate requires administration, Personal representatives needed, Grant of probate or letters of administration. Process: Death certificate registration, Will search, Inheritance tax assessment, Grant application to court, Estate administration

text: Executor and Administrator Duties. Elements: Appointment as executor/administrator, Duty to collect and preserve estate, Duty to pay debts and taxes, Duty to distribute according to will/intestacy. Remedies: Removal of personal representative, Court-ordered administration, Compensation for breach of duty, Beneficiary claims. Remedies: Personal liability for losses, Indemnity from trust property, Beneficiary compensation, Trustee exoneration in some cases. Process: Investigation of trustee conduct, Evidence of breach, Court determination, Remedial orders

text: Adoption Proceedings. Elements: Child under 18 years, Cannot be cared for by birth parents, Adoptive parents suitable, Best interests of child paramount. text: Child Placement for Adoption. Elements: Child in care proceedings, Adoption in child's best interests, No parent consent or consent dispensed with, Placement with approved adopters. text: Security of Tenure. Elements: Statutory continuation of tenancy, No fault eviction possible, Tenant pays rent regularly, Landlord follows correct procedure. text: Mortgagee Possession. Elements: Property mortgaged, Mortgagee exercising power of sale, Tenant's rights protected, Notice requirements met.
